subject: [RFC PATCH 45/57] mm/collapse: take a per-VMA read lock for the round

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the collapse functionality to take a per-VMA read lock instead of holding the mmap_lock across multiple operations. This change allows writers in other parts of the mm to proceed without waiting for the collapse operation, which can be lengthy. The patch also introduces a new error code SCAN_VMA_LOCK to handle cases where the VMA is being written to and cannot be locked for reading. The collapse_revalidate function now checks if the VMA still covers the collected range after the lock has been taken.
